resolutions.reason: Require exact two-field canonical JSON plus LF, source_commit equals full head and header; comments, substrings, extra fields and duplicate keys are rejected.
The supplied regexes contain ^ and [^/], so docs/ and memory/ cannot match root entrypoint rules. Root HTML is actual site code and remains L2; unknown paths stay L3.
protected_prefixes already contains scripts/lib/patchgate. Six existing same-patch constraint tests exercise the explicit paths; the report confused lib/ with scripts/lib/.

additional_same_provider_code_review_fix.resolution: requires_canary is tracked independently of the aggregate maximum risk class; explicit signed mixed-patch test cannot pass without canary.
Parse hunk state rather than discard all +++ lines; eval, a synthetic credential and external host on ++counter source line all produce findings.
Each of HTTP Date, platform observation and request end must individually be fresh against executor time; separate clock skew max 5 seconds. Retained the nearly-15-minute counterexample.

limitations: Code review by OpenAI/Codex is useful QA but not a different-provider or Claude native audit.
No live Cloudflare, distributed CAS or onchain transaction is claimed.
